question.text: Annexure 3 of Chapter 3 is the Application Form for registration of Social Enterprises on NSE SSE. Which of the following is NOT a required field per the 25-row Annexure 3 form?

answer.text: List of top 10 donors for the last 3 FYs along with amounts and percentages
Details of Statutory Auditor including Firm Registration Number
Personal Aadhaar numbers of all beneficiaries reached in the last 3 years

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 84-85 list the 25 fields of Annexure 3, including NGO Darpan ID, top 10 donors for the last 3 FYs with amounts and percentages, and Statutory Auditor details with Firm Registration Number. Beneficiary Aadhaar numbers are not among the 25 fields, so option D is the correct 'not required' choice. The Trap: Option D is a plausible-sounding distractor because Aadhaar appears in many KYC contexts. Annexure 3 is, however, an entity-level registration form and does not require personal Aadhaar numbers of beneficiaries. Note: The Annexure 3 field list on pages 84-85 is sufficient to settle the question; any privacy-law analysis (Aadhaar Act, masking) would require separate sourcing.
